name: DOOM 3 for iPhone (unofficial)
subtitle: The original DOOM 3 and Resurrection of Evil on iPhone.
description:
An unofficial iPhone build of the original 2004 DOOM 3 and its expansion Resurrection of Evil, on dhewm3 (the open-source DOOM 3 engine), with touch controls. Bring your own game files.

It's a beta: expect bugs. Bug reports: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/doom3-ios/issues

Not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, Bethesda Softworks, ZeniMax Media or Microsoft, or by the dhewm3 developers.

apps.name: DOOM 3
apps.subtitle: DOOM 3 and Resurrection of Evil, with touch controls.
apps.localizedDescription:
The original 2004 DOOM 3 and its expansion Resurrection of Evil, in one app, on dhewm3, the open-source DOOM 3 engine.

- Touch controls made for it: a move stick under your left thumb with a run marker, drag to look, FIRE with JUMP, CROUCH, RELOAD and the flashlight round it
- A weapon wheel with every weapon and its ammo
- Tilt aiming (gyro), look speed, quick save and quick load
- CAMERA: photos, selfies, bursts, Action Freeze (stop the world and fly a camera round it) and a cinematic burst
- The PDA by touch
- A main menu laid out for the phone
- A cheat mode: god mode, every weapon, fly, and a level list
- Multiplayer and LibreCoop's co-op (not tested between two phones yet)
- Sound with the phone on silent

You need your own copy of the original DOOM 3 (Steam or GOG, both include it alongside the BFG Edition, whose files don't work): no game files are included. Open the app once, then copy pak000.pk4 to pak008.pk4 from the game's base folder into Files > On My iPhone > DOOM 3 > base (and Resurrection of Evil's d3xp files into d3xp).

It's an unofficial beta: expect bugs, and save often. Full guide: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/doom3-ios/releases/latest

Built on dhewm3 by Daniel Gibson and contributors, from id Software's DOOM 3 GPL source, and on Tom Kidd's DOOM3-iOS. Free software under the GNU GPL v3. Not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, Bethesda Softworks, ZeniMax Media or Microsoft.
